metadata.title: CiteGuard Benchmark Suite (10 Real & Synthetic-Hallucinated Academic Citations)

items.citation: [1] Vaswani A, Shazeer N, Parmar N, et al. Attention Is All You Need[C]//Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems. 2017. arXiv:1706.03762
items.claim_text: Vaswani et al. (2017) proposed the Transformer architecture based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

items.citation: [2] Hu E J, Shen Y, Wallis P, et al. LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models[J]. 2021. arXiv:2106.09685
items.claim_text: LoRA freezes pre-trained model weights and injects trainable rank decomposition matrices into Transformer layers to reduce trainable parameters.

items.citation: [3] Lewis P, Perez E, Piktus A, et al. Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks[C]//NeurIPS. 2020. arXiv:2005.11401
items.claim_text: RAG combines pre-trained parametric memory with a non-parametric dense vector index of Wikipedia, achieving exact 100% factual accuracy without any hallucinations on medical licensing exams.

items.citation: [4] Devlin J, Chang M W, Lee K, et al. BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding[C]//NAACL. 2018. arXiv:1810.04805
items.claim_text: Devlin et al. (2018) restricted BERT pre-training to strictly unidirectional left-to-right causal attention so that it cannot condition on right context.

items.citation: [5] Brown T B, Mann B, Ryder N, et al. Language Models are Few-Shot Learners[C]//NeurIPS. 2020. arXiv:2005.14165
items.claim_text: The Transformer architecture achieves strong zero-shot and few-shot performance by scaling autoregressive language models without gradient updates.

items.citation: [6] Touvron H, Lavril T, Izacard G, et al. Attention Is All You Need[J]. Nature, 2023. arXiv:1706.03762
items.claim_text: Touvron et al. (2023) introduced the Transformer architecture in Nature.

items.citation: [7] Wei J, Wang X, Schuurmans D, et al. Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models[J]. 2019. arXiv:2201.11903
items.claim_text: Chain-of-thought prompting explores how generating intermediate reasoning steps improves complex reasoning in large language models.

items.citation: [8] Chen X, Liu Y. Neural Symbolic Verification for Autonomous Agents[J]. Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research, 2024. doi:10.1145/9999999.8888888
items.claim_text: Chen and Liu (2024) demonstrated a 98.4% reduction in agent tool-call errors using symbolic verification.

items.citation: [9] Zhang W, Miller R. Quantum-Enhanced Prompt Alignment in Clinical LLMs[J]. Nature Medicine, 2025. doi:10.1038/s41591-025-99999-z
items.claim_text: Quantum-enhanced prompt alignment eliminates diagnostic variance across clinical cohorts.

items.citation: [10] Internal Lab Working Group. 2025 年度内部评测基线白皮书[R]. 内部技术报告, 2025.
